headline: On ‘Caribenya,’ Lido Pimienta Found a Lifeline
context: On Lido Pimienta’s new album, “Caribenya,” the Colombian Canadian musician sought a warmer, more complex depiction of Caribbean culture. Creating it helped her rediscover the beauty of living.
